RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.label: a vow broken in the dark
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.description: A colonist whose spouse strayed asks the court to make the marriage mean something, or end it.
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.caseText:
{PETITIONER_labelShort} stands before the court still wearing the ring, and asks the seat to look at what it is worth. {OTHER_labelShort} has been keeping company with {LOVER}, and not discreetly: the colony knew before {PETITIONER_labelShort} did.
The vow was sworn in front of everyone. {PETITIONER_labelShort} wants it to mean something in front of everyone, or to be ended the same way.
How does the lord rule?

li.label: Order {OTHER_labelShort} to give up {LOVER} and keep the vow
Rule that beds are no business of the seat
li.pastLabel: the bed ruled no business of the seat
